Topics covered in this PDF

BGDG-172 (Gender Sensitization: Society and Culture) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Social construction of sexuality, women's labour and employment, gender roles in Indian cinema, reproductive health indicators, gender and disability
  • Patriarchy, forms of masculinity, sexual harassment, gender difference in vocabulary

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: three sections, total marks 100, assignment code ASST /TMA / 2026-27. Section A: two questions of 20 marks (about 500 words). Section B: three questions of 10 marks (about 250 words). Section C: five questions of 6 marks (about 100 words). Question numbers restart in each section, as printed

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
